Knowledge of computer application i.e., Adobe Page Maker, InDesign, Page designing, DTP composing & typesetting etc. in the concerned language.

Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.

Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.

Review all details carefully before submitting the form.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Book Trust India for filling up contract positions in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Editorial Assistant (Hindi) under advertisement number 133/2026/Estt.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Editorial Assistant (Hindi) post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the National Book Trust India Editorial Assistant position is 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation degree along with a Master's Degree in the specified language and relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years as per the official recruitment notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Editorial Assistant (Hindi) post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 45,000/- to Rs. 55,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly online. Interested candidates must submit their forms through the official website.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification released by the National Book Trust India.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification link and the official website (www.nbtindia.gov.in) in the important links section of this article.
